body.text: Stablecoin supply shed roughly $15B in its steepest drop since Terra, even as USDC transaction volume hit a record $1.79T — supply and usage are diverging.
Tether Delisted From Regulated EU Markets as MiCA Bites
USDT was pulled from regulated European exchanges after Tether chose not to pursue a MiCA license; rival Circle secured approval and is expanding its euro-denominated USDC business.
USDC Overtakes USDT in Transaction Volume
Circle's USDC accounted for roughly 70% of adjusted stablecoin transaction volume in H1 2026 versus ~25% for Tether, even though USDT still leads on total market cap after posting a $1.5B Q2 profit.
Stablecoin Supply Posts Biggest Drop Since Terra
Total stablecoin supply shed about $15B, the sharpest contraction since the Terra collapse; analysts attribute it to liquidity rotation rather than panic.
Standard Chartered-Backed HKDAP Set for August Launch
Anchorpoint's Hong Kong dollar stablecoin HKDAP is expected to roll out this month via a B2B2C distribution model for cross-border payments and tokenized assets.
A 2021 firmware flaw that weakened seed randomness let attackers drain 1,816 BTC from over 5,200 addresses starting July 30; maker Coinkite says AI-assisted review failed to catch the bug.
Wanchain Sets Today as Deadline for Cardano Bridge Hacker
Wanchain gave the attacker behind a $10M NIGHT token exploit until Aug 6 to return 90% of the funds in exchange for a 10% white-hat bounty and no legal action.
The Coldcard incident now ranks as the third-largest attack of the year, pushing 2026's cumulative crypto theft past $1.2B across 276 verified incidents.
